# Merge data

```{r Load data}

#Import all data
key <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Glycans whole cohort/SNACK glycans full with lopnr.dta")
names(key)[10] <- "Lopnr"
biomarkers <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/Biomarkers AD ptau217.dta")
bloods <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/Biomarkers baseline SNACK.dta")
bp <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/Blood pressure baseline.dta")
dementia <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/Dementia in SNACK for Robin.dta")
diseases <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/Diseases for Robin baseline.dta")
demographics <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/Variables baseline for Robin.dta")
longitudinal_data <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/MMSE best.dta")
longitudinal_data <- subset(longitudinal_data, select = -MMSE_best0)
apoe_alleles <- read_dta("~/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-KarolinskaInstitutet/Project/04 SNAC-K project/Risk score project/Raw data/APOE alleles.dta")
apoe_alleles <- subset(apoe_alleles, select = c("löpnr", "E2_E3_E4_2014"))
names(apoe_alleles)[1] <- "Lopnr"
names(apoe_alleles)[2] <- "apoe"

# Merge by ID
snac <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "Lopnr", all = TRUE), 
               list(biomarkers, bloods, bp, dementia, diseases, demographics,longitudinal_data, key,                      apoe_alleles))
```

# Quality control

```{r quality control}

# Format glycans as numeric
snac$CV <- as.numeric(snac$CV)
snac$PhaE <- as.numeric(snac$PhaE)

# Distribution of CVs
# Calculate Mean and SD
mu <- mean(snac$CV, na.rm = TRUE)
sigma <- sd(snac$CV, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create the Plot
ggplot(snac, aes(x = CV)) +
  
  # Histogram 
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
                 binwidth = 1,           
                 colour = "black",         
                 fill = "lightgrey") +    
  
  # Density Plot
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2, 
               fill = "#FF6666", 
               color = "red", 
               linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Vertical line at 20%
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 20), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of CVs",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean = ", round(mu, 2), ", SD = ", round(sigma, 2)),
       x = "Coefficient of variation [%]",
       y = "Density")

# CV by plate
plot_data <- snac %>%
  filter(!is.na(Storage_unit))

# Create Boxplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Storage_unit, y = CV, fill = Storage_unit)) +
  
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Individual Points
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgrey") +
  
  # Line at y = 20
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 20), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Plate ID",
    y = "Coefficient of variation [%]",
    title = "CV by Plate",
    fill = "Plate ID"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

#Bisecting GlcNAc by plate

# Create Boxplot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Storage_unit, y = PhaE, fill = Storage_unit)) +
  
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  
  # Individual Points
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgrey") +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Plate ID",
    y = "Bisecting GlcNAc [ratio to pool]",
    title = "Bisecting GlcNAc by Plate",
    fill = "Plate ID"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

# Bisecting GlcNAc and CV by plate position

# Prepare data
plot_data_wide <- snac %>%
  mutate(
    Row = str_extract(Position, "[A-H]"),
    Col = as.numeric(str_extract(Position, "\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Row, Col, Position) %>%
  summarise(
    # Calculate both Mean and SD
    PhaE_Mean = mean(PhaE, na.rm = TRUE),
    PhaE_SD   = sd(PhaE,   na.rm = TRUE),
    CV_Mean   = mean(CV,   na.rm = TRUE),
    CV_SD     = sd(CV,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Row = factor(Row, levels = rev(LETTERS[1:8]))
  )

# Plotting function
create_plate_plot <- function(data, mean_var, sd_var, title_text) {
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Col, y = Row, fill = .data[[mean_var]])) +
    
    # Heatmap
    geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    
    # Text labels
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(round(.data[[mean_var]], 1), "\n(±", round(.data[[sd_var]], 1), ")")), 
      size = 4,         
      color = "white",     
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    
    # Formatting
    coord_fixed() + 
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "cividis") + 
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "") +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

# Generate plots
p1 <- create_plate_plot(plot_data_wide, "PhaE_Mean", "PhaE_SD", "PhaE Mean (±SD)")
p2 <- create_plate_plot(plot_data_wide, "CV_Mean",   "CV_SD",   "CV Mean [%] (±SD)")

ggarrange(p1, p2, ncol = 1, nrow = 2)
```

# Format variables

```{r Format variables}

#Format biomarkers as numeric

snac$abetaratio <- as.numeric(snac$abetaratio)
snac$ptau181 <- as.numeric(snac$ptau181)
snac$ptau217 <- as.numeric(snac$ptau217)
snac$ttau <- as.numeric(snac$ttau)
snac$nfl <- as.numeric(snac$nfl)
snac$gfap <- as.numeric(snac$gfap)
snac$iiGFR <- as.numeric(snac$iiGFR)

#Introduce biomarker cutoff points

snac$ptau217_positive <- ifelse(snac$ptau217 >= 0.134, 1,
                                ifelse(snac$ptau217 < 0.134, 0, NA))
snac$ptau181_positive <- ifelse(snac$ptau181 >= 1.512, 1,
                                ifelse(snac$ptau181 < 1.512, 0, NA))
snac$nfl_positive <- ifelse(snac$nfl >= 20.171, 1,
                            ifelse(snac$nfl < 20.171, 0, NA))
snac$gfap_positive <- ifelse(snac$gfap >= 142.515, 1,
                             ifelse(snac$gfap < 142.515, 0, NA))
snac$ttau_positive <- ifelse(snac$ttau >= 0.832, 1,
                             ifelse(snac$ttau < 0.832, 0, NA))
snac$abeta_positive <- ifelse(snac$abetaratio <= 0.057, 1,
                              ifelse(snac$abetaratio > 0.057, 0, NA))

#Remove glycan NAs, remove CV > 20%, remove glycan < 0.1

snac <- drop_na(snac, "PhaE")
snac <- subset(snac, CV < 20)
snac <- subset(snac, PhaE > 0.1)

#Remove blood samples not matched to any individual in SNAC-K (by excluding by age)
snac <- drop_na(snac, "age")

# Drop individuals with dementia at baseline or no dementia assessment at baseline
snac <- subset(snac, dementia_def22 != 1) # dementia at baseline
snac <- subset(snac, dementia_def22 != 99) # no dementia assessment at baseline

#z-transform biomarkers
snac$PhaE_z <- scale(snac$PhaE)
snac$PhaE_z <- as.numeric(snac$PhaE_z)
snac$abetaratio_z <- scale(snac$abetaratio)
snac$ptau181_z <- scale(snac$ptau181)
snac$ptau217_z <- scale(snac$ptau217)
snac$ttau_z <- scale(snac$ttau)
snac$nfl_z <- scale(snac$nfl)
snac$gfap_z <- scale(snac$gfap)
snac$iiGFR_z <- scale(snac$iiGFR)
```


# Baseline cohort summary statistics

```{r summary statistics}

# Convert factors
df_clean <- snac %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert Sex
    sex = factor(sex, 
                 levels = c(0, 1), 
                 labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    
    # Convert Education
    educ3trnew = factor(educ3trnew, 
                        levels = c(1, 2, 3), 
                        labels = c("Elementary School", 
                                   "High School", 
                                   "University")),
    
    # Convert APOE4
    AnyE4_2014 = factor(AnyE4_2014, 
                        levels = c(0, 1), 
                        labels = c("Non-carrier", "Carrier")),
    
    # Hypertension
    BLHypertension = factor(BLHypertension, 
                     levels = c(0, 1), 
                     labels = c("No Hypertension", "Hypertension")),
    
    # Diabetes
    BLDiabetes = factor(BLDiabetes, 
                     levels = c(0, 1), 
                     labels = c("No Diabetes", "Diabetes")),
    
    #Convert Smoking status
    smoking = case_when(
      R_SMOKE == 2 ~ "Smoker",
      R_SMOKE %in% c(0,1) ~ "Non-smoker"),
    
    #Convert Dementia status
    dementia_recoded = case_when(
      dementia_def22 == 0 ~ "No dementia",
      dementia_def22 == 1 ~ "Dementia at baseline",
      dementia_def22 %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Dementia during follow-up", 
      dementia_def22 == 99 ~ NA_character_ 
    ),
    
    # Set factor levels to control the order in the table
    dementia_recoded = factor(dementia_recoded, 
                              levels = c("No dementia", 
                                         "Dementia at baseline", 
                                         "Dementia during follow-up"))
  )

# Generate table
table1 <- df_clean %>%
  select(age, sex, educ3trnew, AnyE4_2014, BLHypertension, BLDiabetes, smoking, dementia_recoded, MMSE_best0, ptau217, ptau181, ttau, gfap, nfl, abetaratio, PhaE) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      age ~ "Age (years)",
      sex ~ "Sex",
      educ3trnew ~ "Education Level",
      AnyE4_2014 ~ "APOE4 Status",
      BLHypertension ~ "Hypertension",
      BLDiabetes ~ "Diabetes",
      smoking ~ "Smoking",
      dementia_recoded ~ "Dementia Status",
      MMSE_best0 ~ "MMSE Score",
      ptau217 ~ "Blood p-tau217 [pg/mL]",
      ptau181 ~ "Blood p-tau181 [pg/mL]",
      ttau ~ "Blood total tau [pg/mL]",
      gfap ~ "Blood GFAP [pg/mL]",
      nfl ~ "Blood NFL [pg/mL]",
      abetaratio ~ "Blood Aβ42/Aβ40 [ratio]",
      PhaE ~ "Blood bisecting GlcNAc [ratio to pool]"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"
    ),
    missing = "no" 
  ) %>%
  
  # Adds a column showing exactly how many observations exist (N)
  add_n() %>% 
  bold_labels() 

# Print the table
table1
```

# Bisecting GlcNAc correlations with demographic and clinical factors

```{r distribution}

# Calculate Mean and SD
mu <- mean(snac$PhaE_z, na.rm = TRUE)
sigma <- sd(snac$PhaE_z, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create the Plot
ggplot(snac, aes(x = PhaE_z)) +
  
  # Histogram
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), 
                 binwidth = 0.5,          
                 colour = "black",        
                 fill = "lightgrey") +    
  
  # Superimposed Normal Curve
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, 
                args = list(mean = mu, sd = sigma), 
                color = "red", 
                size = 1) +
  
  # Vertical line at the mean
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu), 
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of bisecting GlcNAc (z-score)",
       subtitle = paste0("Mean = ", round(mu, 2), ", SD = ", round(sigma, 2)),
       x = "Bisecting GlcNAc [z-score]",
       y = "Density")
```

```{r age and kidney function correlations}

#Correlation with age
ggplot(snac, aes(x = age, y = PhaE_z)) +
  
  # Scatter Points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "darkgrey") + 
  
  # Regression Line with 95% CI
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    formula = y ~ x, 
    color = "black", 
    fill = "grey60",
    se = TRUE,  
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Pearson Correlation (Black, Top Left)
  stat_cor(
    method = "pearson", 
    label.x.npc = "left", 
    label.y.npc = 1.0, 
    size = 4, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Spearman Correlation (Red, Below Pearson)
  stat_cor(
    method = "spearman", 
    label.x.npc = "left", 
    label.y.npc = 0.90, 
    size = 4, 
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Age [years]",
    y = "Bisecting GlcNAc [z-score]",
    caption = "Black: Pearson's r | Red: Spearman's rho"
  )

#Correlation with kidney function
ggplot(snac, aes(x = iiGFR, y = PhaE_z)) +
  
  # Scatter Points
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "darkgrey") + 
  
  # Regression Line with 95% CI
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    formula = y ~ x, 
    color = "black", 
    fill = "grey60",
    se = TRUE,      
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Pearson Correlation (Black, Top Left)
  stat_cor(
    method = "pearson", 
    label.x.npc = "left", 
    label.y.npc = 1.0, 
    size = 4, 
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Spearman Correlation (Red, Below Pearson)
  stat_cor(
    method = "spearman", 
    label.x.npc = "left", 
    label.y.npc = 0.90, 
    size = 4, 
    color = "red"
  ) +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "GFR [ml/min]",
    y = "Bisecting GlcNAc [z-score]",
    caption = "Black: Pearson's r | Red: Spearman's rho"
  )
```

```{r sex and dementia status boxplots}

# Boxplot by sex
# Label sex
plot_data <- snac %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  mutate(
    sex_label = factor(sex, 
                       levels = c(0, 1), 
                       labels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

# Create Boxplot with T-test
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = sex_label, y = PhaE_z, fill = sex_label)) +
  
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Individual Points
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgrey") +
  
  # t-test (Unpaired, Two-tailed)
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "t.test",      
    paired = FALSE,         
    label.x.npc = "center", 
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Formatting
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#377eb8", "Female" = "#e41a1c")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Bisecting GlcNAc [z-score]",
    title = "",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#Boxplot by dementia status

# Define dementia status
plot_data <- snac %>%
  mutate(
    dementia_recoded = case_when(
      dementia_def22 == 0 ~ "No dementia",
      dementia_def22 %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8) ~ "Dementia during follow-up",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    dementia_recoded = factor(dementia_recoded, 
                              levels = c("No dementia", 
                                         "Dementia during follow-up"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(dementia_recoded))

# Create plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = dementia_recoded, y = PhaE_z, fill = dementia_recoded)) +
  
  # Boxplot with Jitter
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, color = "darkgrey") +
   
  # t-test (Unpaired, Two-tailed)
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "t.test",      
    paired = FALSE,         
    label.x.npc = "center", 
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  # Formatting
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") + 
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Bisecting GlcNAc [z-score]",
    title = "",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r cardiovascular risk factor boxplots}
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Bisecting GlcNAc correlations with biomarkers

```{r heatmap}

# Define Variables
biomarkers <- c("abetaratio_z", "ptau181_z", "ptau217_z", "ttau_z", "nfl_z", "gfap_z")
predictor  <- "PhaE_z"

# Helper function for significance stars based on adjusted p-values
get_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ ""
  )
}

# Correlation Function
get_corrs <- function(data, label) {
  map_dfr(biomarkers, function(bm) {
    test <- cor.test(data[[predictor]], data[[bm]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    
    tibble(
      Biomarker = bm,
      rho       = unname(test$estimate),
      p_raw     = test$p.value,
      Group     = label
    )
  })
}

# Compute and Apply Multiple Comparison Correction
summary_df <- bind_rows(
  get_corrs(snac, "Whole Cohort"),
  get_corrs(snac %>% filter(AnyE4_2014 == 1), "E4 Carriers"),
  get_corrs(snac %>% filter(AnyE4_2014 == 0), "E4 Non-Carriers")
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),  # or "bonferroni", "holm", "BY"
    stars = get_stars(p_adj),
    cell_label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), stars)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Whole Cohort", "E4 Carriers", "E4 Non-Carriers")),
    Biomarker = factor(Biomarker, levels = rev(biomarkers))
  )

# Plot Heatmap
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Group, y = Biomarker, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limit = c(-1, 1), name = "Spearman's rho") +
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), color = "black", size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

# Exploratory analysis 1: Biomarker correlations by allele dosage

```{r allele dosage correlations}

# Define Variables
biomarkers <- c("abetaratio_z", "ptau181_z", "ptau217_z", "ttau_z", "nfl_z", "gfap_z")
predictor  <- "PhaE_z"
genotypes  <- c("E2/E4", "E3/E4", "E4/E4")

# Helper function for significance stars based on adjusted p-values
get_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
    p < 0.001  ~ "***",
    p < 0.01   ~ "**",
    p < 0.05   ~ "*",
    TRUE       ~ ""
  )
}

# Correlation Function
get_corrs <- function(data, label) {
  map_dfr(biomarkers, function(bm) {
    valid_data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor]]), !is.na(.data[[bm]]))
    n_obs <- nrow(valid_data)
    
    if (n_obs >= 3) {
      test    <- cor.test(valid_data[[predictor]], valid_data[[bm]], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
      rho_val <- unname(test$estimate)
      p_val   <- test$p.value
    } else {
      rho_val <- NA_real_
      p_val   <- NA_real_
    }
    
    tibble(
      Biomarker = bm,
      rho       = rho_val,
      p_raw     = p_val,
      n         = n_obs,
      Group     = label
    )
  })
}

# Calculate group sample sizes for X-axis labels: "Genotype\n(n = X)"
group_labels <- map_chr(genotypes, function(gt) {
  n_total <- snac %>% 
    filter(apoe == gt, !is.na(.data[[predictor]])) %>% 
    nrow()
  paste0(gt, "\n(n = ", n_total, ")")
})
names(group_labels) <- genotypes

# Compute, Correct across all comparisons, and format labels
summary_df <- map_dfr(genotypes, ~ get_corrs(snac %>% filter(apoe == .x), .x)) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj      = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
    stars      = get_stars(p_adj),
    cell_label = if_else(!is.na(rho), paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), stars), "NA"),
    Group_Label = factor(group_labels[Group], levels = group_labels),
    Biomarker   = factor(Biomarker, levels = rev(biomarkers))
  )

# Plot Heatmap
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Group_Label, y = Biomarker, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette  = "RdBu", 
    limit    = c(-1, 1), 
    name     = "Spearman's rho",
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = cell_label), color = "black", size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid  = element_blank()
  )
```


# Longitudinal cognition

```{r longitudinal cognition}

# Median split to define glycan positivity
med_val <- median(snac$PhaE, na.rm = TRUE)
snac$glycan_positive <- ifelse(snac$PhaE > med_val, 1, 0)

df_long <- snac %>%
  
  # pre-cleaning
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(Lopnr, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  
  # rename and pivot
  rename(
    MMSE_wave1 = MMSE_best0,
    MMSE_wave2 = MMSE_best1,
    MMSE_wave3 = MMSE_best2,
    MMSE_wave4 = MMSE_best3,
    MMSE_wave5 = MMSE_best4,
    MMSE_wave6 = MMSE_best5
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("MMSE"), starts_with("date")),
    names_to = c(".value", "wave"), 
    names_pattern = "(.*)_wave(\\d)" 
  ) %>%
  
  # formatting
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    wave = as.numeric(wave),
    MMSE = as.numeric(MMSE) # Ensure scores are numeric
  ) %>%
  
  # calculate time
  group_by(Lopnr) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_date = date[wave == 1][1], 
    time_years = if_else(is.na(baseline_date), NA_real_, 
                         as.numeric(difftime(date, baseline_date, units = "days")) / 365.25)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # Remove MMSE NAs
  mutate(MMSE = na_if(MMSE, 0)) %>%  # treat 0 as NA
  filter(!is.na(MMSE))              


# Linear mixed models

# Standardized optimizer control
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

# Whole cohort analysis
model <- lmer(
  MMSE ~ time_years * glycan_positive + age + sex + educ3trnew + 
    gfap_positive + ptau217_positive + nfl_positive + (1 | Lopnr),
  data = df_long,
  REML = TRUE,
  control = ctrl
)
summary(model)

# Stratify whole cohort by glycan status
whole_pos <- subset(df_long, glycan_positive == "1")
whole_neg <- subset(df_long, glycan_positive == "0")

posmodel_whole <- lmer(
  MMSE ~ time_years + age + sex + educ3trnew + gfap_positive + ptau217_positive + nfl_positive + (1 | Lopnr),
  data = whole_pos,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = ctrl
)
pos_pred_whole <- ggpredict(posmodel_whole, terms = "time_years [all]")

negmodel_whole <- lmer(
  MMSE ~ time_years + age + sex + educ3trnew + gfap_positive + ptau217_positive + nfl_positive + (1 | Lopnr),
  data = whole_neg,
  REML = FALSE,
  control = ctrl
)
neg_pred_whole <- ggpredict(negmodel_whole, terms = "time_years [all]")

plot_main <- ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = pos_pred_whole, aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "#d62728", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = pos_pred_whole, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), fill = "#d62728", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = neg_pred_whole, aes(x = x, y = predicted), color = "#1f77b4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = neg_pred_whole, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), fill = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(18, 30), breaks = seq(18, 30, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Expected MMSE Trajectory (Whole Cohort)",
    subtitle = "Red = Glycan Positive, Blue = Glycan Negative",
    x = "Years since baseline",
    y = "MMSE"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

print(plot_main)
```

# Survival analysis

```{r Cox regression}

# Add variable "incident dementia during followup"
snac$dementia <- ifelse(snac$dementia_def22 >= 2 & snac$dementia_def22 <= 8, 1,
                 ifelse(snac$dementia_def22 == 0, 0, NA))

# Drop individuals without followup
snac <- subset(snac, time_to_dementia22 != 0)

#Define survival object
snac$surv_obj <- Surv(time = snac$time_to_dementia22, event = snac$dementia)

# Run Whole Cohort Model
model_whole <- coxph(surv_obj ~ glycan_positive + age + AnyE4_2014 + sex + educ3trnew + gfap_positive + nfl_positive + ptau217_positive, data = snac)

summary (model_whole)

# Check assumptions
ph_test <- cox.zph(model_whole)
ph_test
plot(ph_test)

# Define base variables
base_vars <- c("ptau217_positive", "gfap_positive", "nfl_positive", "glycan_positive", "age", "sex", "educ3trnew", "AnyE4_2014")

# Define a function to run Cox models on subgroups
run_subgroup_cox <- function(data, group_var, covariates) {
  
  # Dynamic Formula
  current_vars <- setdiff(covariates, group_var)
  f <- as.formula(paste("surv_obj ~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  
  # Pipeline: Filter NAs -> Group -> Nest -> Model -> Tidy
  results <- data %>%
    drop_na(all_of(group_var)) %>% 
    group_by(across(all_of(group_var))) %>%
    nest() %>%
    mutate(
      model = map(data, ~coxph(f, data = .x)),
      tidy_stats = map(model, ~tidy(.x, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    unnest(tidy_stats) %>%
    select(-data, -model)
  
  return(results)
}

# Run the models

  # Stratify by APOE4 Status
  res_apoe <- run_subgroup_cox(snac, "AnyE4_2014", base_vars)
  print (res_apoe)

  # Stratify by sex
  res_sex <- run_subgroup_cox(snac, "sex", base_vars)
  print (res_sex)

```

# Competing risk analysis (Fine-Gray model)

```{r competing risk}

# Ensure date formatting
snac$Start <- as.Date(snac$Start)
snac$death_date_new <- as.Date(snac$death_date_new)

# Calculate time to death from baseline in years
snac$time_to_death <- as.numeric(difftime(snac$death_date_new, snac$Start, units = "days")) / 365.25

# Define multi-state event status
# 0 = Censored, 1 = Dementia, 2 = Death without dementia
snac$event_cr <- ifelse(snac$dementia == 1, 1,
                 ifelse(snac$dementia == 0 & snac$dead_register_new == 1, 2,
                 ifelse(snac$dementia == 0 & snac$dead_register_new == 0, 0, NA)))

# Define event time for competing risks
snac$time_cr <- ifelse(snac$event_cr == 2 & !is.na(snac$time_to_death), 
                       snac$time_to_death, 
                       snac$time_to_dementia22)

# Convert competing risk event to a factor
snac$event_cr_factor <- factor(snac$event_cr, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Censored", "Dementia", "Death"))

# Drop individuals without followup or missing event/time
snac <- subset(snac, time_cr != 0 & !is.na(time_cr) & !is.na(event_cr_factor))

# Unadjusted Competing Risk Model
cr_model_glycan_only <- crr(
  Surv(time_cr, event_cr_factor) ~ glycan_positive,
  data = snac,
  failcode = "Dementia"
)

summary(cr_model_glycan_only)
tidy(cr_model_glycan_only, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
print (cr_model_glycan_only)

# Fine-Gray Subdistribution Hazard Model for Dementia
cr_model_whole <- crr(
  Surv(time_cr, event_cr_factor) ~ glycan_positive + age + AnyE4_2014 + sex + 
    educ3trnew + gfap_positive + nfl_positive + ptau217_positive,
  data = snac,
  failcode = "Dementia"
)

# Output summary with Subdistribution Hazard Ratios (sHR)
summary(cr_model_whole)
tidy(cr_model_whole, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)
print (cr_model_whole)

# Subgroup analysis

base_vars <- c("ptau217_positive", "gfap_positive", "nfl_positive", "glycan_positive", "age", "sex", "educ3trnew", "AnyE4_2014")

run_subgroup_crr <- function(data, group_var, covariates) {
  
  current_vars <- setdiff(covariates, group_var)
  f <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time_cr, event_cr_factor) ~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  
  results <- data %>%
    drop_na(all_of(group_var)) %>% 
    group_by(across(all_of(group_var))) %>% 
    nest() %>% 
    mutate(
      model = map(data, ~crr(f, data = .x, failcode = "Dementia")),
      tidy_stats = map(model, ~tidy(.x, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE))
    ) %>% 
    unnest(tidy_stats) %>% 
    select(-data, -model)
  
  return(results)
}

# Stratify by APOE4 Status
res_cr_apoe <- run_subgroup_crr(snac, "AnyE4_2014", base_vars)
print(res_cr_apoe)

# Stratify by sex
res_cr_sex <- run_subgroup_crr(snac, "sex", base_vars)
print(res_cr_sex)
```

# Forest plot

```{r Forest plot}
# Run Whole Cohort Model
model_whole <- coxph(surv_obj ~ glycan_positive + age + sex + educ3trnew + AnyE4_2014 + gfap_positive + ptau217_positive + nfl_positive, data = snac)

res_whole <- tidy(model_whole, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(group_label = "Whole Cohort", category = "All")

# Process Subgroups (Clean labels for the plot)

# Process APOE
plot_apoe <- res_apoe %>%
  mutate(group_label = ifelse(AnyE4_2014 == 0, "APOE4 Non-Carrier", "APOE4 Carrier"),
         category = "APOE4 allele status")

# Process Sex
plot_sex <- res_sex %>%
  mutate(group_label = ifelse(sex == 0, "Male", "Female"),
         category = "Sex")

# Combine everything and filter for 'glycan_positive'
plot_data <- bind_rows(res_whole, plot_apoe, plot_sex) %>%
  filter(grepl("glycan_positive", term)) %>% 
  select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, group_label, category)

# Define order of y-axis (Whole cohort at bottom, subgroups above)
plot_data$group_label <- factor(plot_data$group_label, 
                                levels = c("Whole Cohort", 
                                           "APOE4 Non-Carrier", "APOE4 Carrier", 
                                           "Male", "Female"))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = estimate, y = group_label, color = category)) +
  
  # Add reference line at HR = 1
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  
  # Add Error Bars (95% CI)
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  
  # Add Point Estimates (HR)
  geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 18) +
  
  # Add text labels for the actual HR values
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(estimate, 2), " (", 
                               round(conf.low, 2), "-", 
                               round(conf.high, 2), ")")), 
            vjust = -1, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  
  # Customization
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + 
  labs(
    x = "Adjusted Hazard Ratio (aHR) of glycan positivity for dementia",
    y = "",
    color = "Subgroup Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# Exploratory analysis 3: Cumulative incidence plot by exact APOE genotype

```{r cumulative incidence}

# Filter dataset for the 3 target genotypes and ensure complete variables
snac_sub <- snac %>%
  filter(
    apoe %in% c("E2/E4", "E3/E4", "E4/E4"),
    !is.na(glycan_positive),
    !is.na(time_to_dementia22),
    !is.na(dementia)
  )

# Create readable 6-group strata variable
snac_sub <- snac_sub %>%
  mutate(
    glycan_label = if_else(glycan_positive == 1, "Glycan+", "Glycan-"),
    strata = factor(
      paste0(apoe, " (", glycan_label, ")"),
      levels = c(
        "E2/E4 (Glycan-)", "E2/E4 (Glycan+)",
        "E3/E4 (Glycan-)", "E3/E4 (Glycan+)",
        "E4/E4 (Glycan-)", "E4/E4 (Glycan+)"
      )
    )
  )

# Set reference category
contrasts(snac_sub$strata) <- contr.treatment(
  levels(snac_sub$strata), 
  base = 3
)

# Fit Survival and Cox Proportional Hazards Models
fit <- survfit(Surv(time_to_dementia22, dementia) ~ strata, data = snac_sub)
cox_mod <- coxph(Surv(time_to_dementia22, dementia) ~ strata, data = snac_sub)

# Generate HR annotation string from the Cox model
cox_summary <- summary(cox_mod)
ref_group   <- levels(snac_sub$strata)[1]

hr_lines <- c(paste0("Ref: E3/E4 (Glycan-)"))
coef_tab <- cox_summary$conf.int

for (i in seq_len(nrow(coef_tab))) {
  group_name <- gsub("^strata", "", rownames(coef_tab)[i])
  hr   <- sprintf("%.2f", coef_tab[i, "exp(coef)"])
  low  <- sprintf("%.2f", coef_tab[i, "lower .95"])
  high <- sprintf("%.2f", coef_tab[i, "upper .95"])
  hr_lines <- c(hr_lines, paste0("HR (", group_name, "): ", hr, " [", low, ", ", high, "]"))
}

hr_text <- paste(hr_lines, collapse = "\n")

# Plot Cumulative Incidence
p <- ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data           = snac_sub,
  fun            = "event",          
  risk.table     = TRUE,
  pval           = TRUE,
  conf.int       = FALSE,             
  legend.title   = "APOE / Glycan Status",
  legend.labs    = levels(snac_sub$strata),
  palette        = "Paired",          
  xlab           = "Years from baseline",
  ylab           = "Cumulative incidence of dementia",
  ggtheme        = theme_bw()
)

# Add HR text annotation to the incidence plot
p$plot <- p$plot + 
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.85, label = hr_text, hjust = 0, size = 3.2)

# Print final figure with risk table
print(p)
```


# RMS model

```{r rms model}

# Convert relevant covariates to factors
factor_vars <- c("sex", "educ3trnew", "AnyE4_2014", "gfap_positive", "nfl_positive", "ptau217_positive")

snac[factor_vars] <- lapply(snac[factor_vars], as.factor)

# Subset and Clean
vars_needed <- c("time_to_dementia22", "dementia", "age", "PhaE_z", "PhaE", factor_vars)
snac_clean <- na.omit(snac[, vars_needed])

# Setup Model Distribution
dd <- datadist(snac_clean)
options(datadist = 'dd')

# Unadjusted model
fit_rcs <- cph(Surv(time_to_dementia22, dementia) ~ 
                 rcs(PhaE_z, 3), 
                 data = snac_clean, x=TRUE, y=TRUE)

# Fit the Adjusted Cox Model with Splines
fit_rcs <- cph(Surv(time_to_dementia22, dementia) ~ 
                 rcs(PhaE_z, 3) + gfap_positive + ptau217_positive + nfl_positive + age + sex + 
                 educ3trnew + AnyE4_2014, 
                 data = snac_clean, x=TRUE, y=TRUE)

# Extract predictions for the plot
pred_hr <- Predict(fit_rcs, PhaE_z, ref.zero = TRUE, fun = exp)
pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred_hr)

# Create the Final Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_df, aes(x = PhaE_z, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = pred_df, aes(x = PhaE_z, y = yhat), color = "black", size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "solid", color = "#b2182b", size = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = 'log2', breaks = c(0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64)) +
  labs(x = "Bisecting GlcNAc [z-score]", 
       y = "Adjusted hazard ratio (aHR) for dementia", 
       title = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
